d:
A catalog from the distribution circle Kagekidan Musō-in featuring several imprints that were or would go on sale by 1985. All of the works are yaoi / BL centric and feature a few Aniparo works in the scheme of original projects, such as manga and novels. This piece was acquired from the collection of an Anonymous fudanshi I met on Facebook last year when I was covering the history of the circle Glass. Many of the works were slated for 1985 although the booklet is from mid 1984.

As an information catalog, many of these works found more success outside of the Comiket or Comitia circuit due to strong self-ran mail order businesses, contacts as well as the proliferation of these works being sold at adult bookstores catering to queer men. Many artists present range from Kage Miyabi to Shikiko Yamaii, several of which had a major following. Some texts advertised I do own, so I'll archive them soon.
